title: Design System: Masarrah HR — مسرة إتش أر للاستقدام

display.purpose: Hero lead-ins and major section opens on navy. One serif crown per page.

title.displayName: Title — Inter / IBM Plex Sans Arabic
title.purpose: Card titles, accordion questions, nav items.

body.displayName: Body — Inter / IBM Plex Sans Arabic
body.purpose: Page voice. Ink on parchment, parchment on navy. Max 65–75ch.

label.displayName: Label Caps — Inter / IBM Plex Sans Arabic
label.purpose: Eyebrows flanked by ◆ diamond dividers, nav meta, button labels (600).

shadows.name: Float
shadows.purpose: The one elevation for floating panels, menus, dialogs; hover lift becomes a gentle float.

shadows.name: Apparatus
shadows.purpose: The WhatsApp call-to-action, the single floating brand seal on every page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hovers, active states).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover and state transitions — restrained and formal.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile → tablet: 1-column grid → 2-column, stat band 2×2 → row.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet → desktop: 2-column grid → 3–4 columns, full nav visible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single Court Gold seal per screen; the ask of the embassy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #C9A227; color: #0B1B3A; font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 32px; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E1BE5E; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #B28E20; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The measured outline alternative; secondary path on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #0B1B3A; font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 13px 30px; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px solid #C9A227; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(240, 216, 137, 0.15); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Marble face, hairline ink border, gold focus ring — form fields for the request form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #4A4E5A; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #111318; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 19, 24, 0.15); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A1A6B5; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A227; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.4); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Whole-card tap target in the service grid; flat at rest, one-step hover lift.
components.html: استقدام العمالة المنزليةمنزلية · مكتبية
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 19, 24, 0.12); border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11,27,58,0.12); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; background: #F5EFDD; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #111318; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 13px; color: #4A4E5A; }

components.name: FAQ Accordion
components.description: Exclusive accordion; navy chevron turns Court Gold when open.
components.html: مدة العقد القياسية سنتان، مع إمكانية التجديد.
components.css: .ds-accordion { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(17, 19, 24, 0.12); font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-accordion-q { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 4px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #111318; text-align: start; } .ds-accordion-q:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chevron { transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), stroke 150ms; } .ds-accordion-q[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); stroke: #C9A227; } .ds-accordion-a { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 250ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-accordion-q[aria-expanded="true"] + .ds-accordion-a { max-height: 300px; } .ds-accordion-a p { margin: 0 0 20px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; color: #4A4E5A; }

components.name: Stat Number
components.description: Court Gold Latin numerals with an Ink Soft uppercase caption; trust band.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Amiri', 'Noto Naskh Arabic', serif; } .ds-stat-num { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; color: #C9A227; font-family: 'Cormorant', 'Amiri', serif; } .ds-stat-cap { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A4E5A; font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; }

components.name: WhatsApp Floating Button
components.description: The Apparatus-shadowed gold seal, fixed bottom-end on every page; zero-dependency.
components.css: .ds-fab { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; inset-inline-end: 24px; width: 56px; height: 56px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #C9A227; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(11,27,58,0.25); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background 150ms; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #E1BE5E; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A227; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Masarrah HR is not a startup polished white. It is a sovereign room — a place of record where foreign workers are brought into Saudi homes and companies with formality, ceremony, and absolute legal assurance. The brand wears the dress uniform of an embassy: walls of deep mission navy, beading of restrained gold, and a staff that speaks in full, unhurried sentences. Every surface below exists to make a visitor feel on hallowed ground — that their household, their employee, and their contract are being handled by an institution, not a middleman. The system is monumental but quiet: one navy canvas, one gold accent, generous white space, hairline borders instead of shadows, and typography that carries the state's word. The relationship between navy and gold is deliberate and ritualistic: navy is the estate itself, gold is the signature that seals decisions.
keyCharacteristics: A single navy estate (deep navy surfaces) with gold used as a seal, never a palette — ≤10% of any screen.
Borders over shadows: 1px hairline is the depth language; shadows are reserved for floating elements.
Formal stillness: restrained 150–250ms transitions, no bounce, no scale-on-hover, no parallax in page chrome.
Arabic first (RTL), English as a faithful mirror via logical properties — never two hand-built layouts.
Accessible by default: 44px touch targets, small gold text banned, full prefers-reduced-motion support.
The ◆ diamond and the necktie silhouette are the only recurring brand motifs — used as ceremony, never as filler.

rules.name: The Gilding Rule
rules.body: Gold is a seal, not a wash. On any screen, gold covers at most ~10% of the visible area: one primary CTA, an eyebrow, a stat numeral. If a section starts to look 'gold-themed', gold has been overused.

rules.name: The Flat Gilding Rule
rules.body: The metallic gradient in the logo is a brand-mark-only effect. In UI, always flat gold 500 (#C9A227) for buttons, links, icons, and numerals. Gradients at small sizes are illegible and fail contrast.

rules.name: The Latin Numerals Rule
rules.body: Arabic sentences use Western numerals — '27 عاماً' not '٢٧'. Phone numbers, prices, stats always appear with Latin digits.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: The serif voice is for hero and section openings only. It must never appear in dense UI copy, labels, or multiple headings on one screen — one serif crown per page.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth is carried by tonal layering — navy on parchment, chancellery on embassy — never by shadow. Surfaces are flat at rest; elevation and shadow appear only as a response to state (hover, an open dialog), never as ambient decoration.

dos: Do reserve Court Gold for the one primary CTA per screen; gold is a seal, and more gold makes it less important gold.
Do set body paragraphs in Ink on parchment and white on navy — gold never appears under 18px as body text.
Do lead the page's emotional rhythm with the light/dark banding (marble → parchment → navy → marble).
Do keep Arabic default and RTL with logical properties; English is the mirror.
Do give every tappable a 44×44px touch area and respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable lifts, fades, and the accordion animation).
donts: Don't use full-pill radius, glassmorphism, heavy gradients — the embassy is not tech-startup retail.
Don't put a necktie motif on every other block; it's the signature stamp, mark of the mark only.
Don't use shadows as background depth; shadow means 'this floats now' (dialog, FAB), nothing else.
Don't hand-build a separate English layout — mirror Arabic with logical props.
Don't ship gold text on parchment and don't set small-caps gold anywhere below 18px. Contrast is the seal of the contract.
